subject: executor: make `checksum` block gc (#51293)
summary: Diff only reorders `ExecStmt.Exec()` in `pkg/executor/adapter.go` so `SetProcessInfo(...)` (and thus `ProcessInfo.CurTxnStartTS` / visibility to GC safepoint blocker via reported minStartTS) happens before `openExecutor()`; this matters for `ADMIN CHECKSUM TABLE` because most work happens inside `ChecksumTableExec.Open()`. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/concurrency/txn behavior for this change; later `upstream/master` keeps the same ordering (with additional unrelated refinements around `max_execution_time`).
